source.redistribution_decision: The babadbali.com Wuku page is the governing source for the wuku-table-fix-20260919 engine change (governance decision 2026-09-19). The page bytes are NOT committed to the repository. Per the project's established precedent (STATUS.json:178, wariga_kemendikbud_hindu_bs_kls_ix_2022 reason field), explicit redistribution permission was not identified for this page; only minimum evidence necessary to verify the engine change is retained in this package. The minimum evidence is the 30 Nama Bali link-text strings recorded verbatim below in sample_data.nama_bali_link_text_extracted. The page itself exists only as a transient retrieval copy on the build host, retained outside the public tree at /home/alex/workspace/transfer/babadbali-wuku.html (also unpushed). SHA-256 and byte count above describe that transient copy; they are recorded here so a future re-fetch can be verified against the same bytes, not so the bytes themselves are vendored.
source.precedent_reference: phase-1/conformance/STATUS.json:178 (wariga_kemendikbud_hindu_bs_kls_ix_2022). The Kemendikbud textbook carries a standard Indonesian government copyright assertion with no open-content license; the package retains only minimum-evidence quotes, not the full PDF. The same reasoning applies here: babadbali.com's public terms do not authorise redistribution of the page itself.

sample_data.extraction_notes: Nama Bali column is the link text inside <a href="uku/NN*.htm">. Nama Jawa column is the adjacent <td>; explicitly NOT a Balinese spelling. Urip values are integers in [1..9].
sample_data.minimum_evidence_rationale: These 30 strings are the minimum evidence necessary to verify that WUKU_NAMES_BALINESE in the engine matches the babadbali canonical ordering. The page itself is not vendored because its redistribution status is uncertain; the strings are vendored because they are the precise assertion the engine fix relies on.

extraction_context.method: curl + parse from public babadbali.com URL

scope_limitations: Wuku/Pancawara ordering claims only — not customary attestation
Nama Bali link-text column is governing for Balinese spelling; Nama Jawa column is Javanese and must not be substituted
no aksara Bali column on this page; balinese_script is empty across WUKU_I18N
